_doc: Captain head-and-shoulders portrait parts, drawn by game/InkRenderer.js (brush-ink) and composed by game/PortraitRenderer.js. HEAD parts (heads/faces/hairs/facialHair/headgear) share one coordinate frame centred on the head (crown ~y-0.6, chin ~y0.56). SHOULDERS parts use their own frame (collar top ~y-0.5). Coords normalised to ~[-1,1]; `role` selects an ink colour (skin/hair/coat/accent/trim/metal/hat/ink). Faces are `lacy` so they draw as see-through detail over the head. A captain's parts are chosen deterministically in game/sim/captains.js.
